summary: Fractyl Health issued a press release disclosing one-year clinical trial results for its Revita DMR System, not a special-situation corporate event. The 8-K items 7.01 and 8.01 report data from the REMAIN-1 Midpoint Cohort evaluating weight maintenance after GLP-1 discontinuation. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation transaction is involved. The filing is a routine disclosure of clinical study outcomes with no corporate action triggering special-situation classification.
